reports.title: Veradermics Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Highlights Recent Corporate and Clinical Progress

desk.headline: Pre-revenue; net loss of $21.0m ($0.50 a share), narrower than expected; $798.4m cash funds work into 2030; no financial guidance
results: Veradermics has no product sales yet; the net loss was $21.0m, or $0.50 a share, a smaller loss than the $0.62 analysts expected.
Research spending fell to $16.1m as trial costs eased, while admin costs jumped to $12.7m on staff, share-based pay and launch preparation.
Interest income of $5.1m on its large cash pile cushioned the loss.
Cash and investments of $798.4m are expected to last into 2030, through further late-stage trial results and a possible launch.
Its oral hair-loss pill VDPHL01 met all main goals in a Phase 3 men's trial, and 12-month data from a second men's trial were also positive.

guidance.summary: As a clinical-stage drug developer, Veradermics gives no revenue or earnings guidance. It points to cash lasting into 2030 and topline data from its women's Phase 2/3 study in the first half of 2027.

watch: Topline results from Study 306 in women with pattern hair loss, due in the first half of 2027.
Timing of a US marketing application for VDPHL01.
Spending on launch preparation as admin costs climb.
